Container.Name: immich-folio
Container.Overview:
Immich Folio is a lightweight, high-performance web application designed to present and showcase photos from an existing Immich instance in an elegant gallery view.
Setup Instructions: 1. AUTH_SECRET: You MUST enter a long, random string for "Auth Secret". This is required for session security and encryption. 2. FIRST RUN SETUP TOKEN: When you start the container for the first time, check the Container Logs in Unraid. You will find a generated Setup Token there, which is REQUIRED to complete the initial setup wizard in your browser! 3. Setup Wizard: Open the WebUI and enter your Setup Token, Immich URL, API Key, and set your Admin Password during the first-time setup process. 4. ADMIN_PASSWORD (Optional): Leave this blank during initial setup. You can populate this variable later if you ever need to reset or override your Admin Password via container environment variables.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port to access Immich Folio (Internal and External: 7211)

Config.Name: Appdata Path
Config.Description: Storage location for gallery configuration and content (where the setup wizard saves its data).

Config.Name: Auth Secret
Config.Description: Required! Provide a long, random string (e.g., a 32-character secret) used for session security.

Config.Name: Admin Password
Config.Description: Optional. Leave blank on initial setup (you will create your password in the Setup Wizard). Use this variable later if you need to reset your admin password.
